svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Shaft: 16 mm bright steel bar, 419 mm long.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cams (make 2): discs 72 mm across, 12 mm thick, with a 16 mm bore

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: whose centre is 22 mm from the disc centre (the cam's throw).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Crank: 10 mm flat bar 24 wide, 74 long, ends rounded; 16 mm bore at

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: one end, a 10 mm pin 18 long welded at the other, 50 mm apart.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Slide the shaft through both front hangers, then slide on a cam each

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: side (outer faces 198 mm from the centre line) and the crank on the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: With the cams' thick side straight down and the crank pin straight

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: up, drill a 5 mm hole through each hub and the shaft; fit roll pins.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the shaft turns freely; cams and crank do not slip on it.
